shop.title: Your Velopass is ready
shop.desc: Chances are your Velopass is already waiting for you via your bike shop. Your bike is registered — just pick a password and everything is ready.
shop.body: Your bike shop has applied the Frame-ID and registered your bike in your name. All you need to do is choose a password.

order.title: Order a Velopass Frame-ID
order.desc: From €12.95. Free shipping. Instantly protected via your digital bike passport.
order.body: One Frame-ID activates your digital passport for the entire lifetime of your bike. One-time purchase — no subscription, no hidden costs.

second_hand.title: The passport moves with you. In your name.
second_hand.desc: Bought a second-hand bike with an existing Velopass Frame-ID? Register it in your name — the passport simply transfers.
second_hand.body: Bought a second-hand bike with an existing Velopass Frame-ID? You can easily transfer the digital passport to your name. The neutral bike history (service visits, repairs and warranty data) comes with it. Personal services such as roadside assistance and insurance you activate yourself. Invoices, prices and personal photos stay private with the previous owner.

benefits.title: One Frame-ID. A whole bike life sorted.
